# The seeded pre-screen for the typosquat check (TestSeededTyposquats).
#
# squat <eco> <name> <the package it imitates>
# legit <eco> <name>
#
# The squats are real typosquat names from public incident reports, or
# the same patterns applied to the most imitated packages: the 2017 npm
# batch (crossenv and 37 others), the PyPI campaigns (urlib3, colourama,
# jeIlyfish, python3-dateutil), the Go case squat of
# github.com/Sirupsen/logrus and the 2025 github.com/boltdb-go/bolt.
# Where the imitated package is not on the well-known list the check
# cannot know it in an empty project; those rows count as misses, as
# they would in use. The legit rows are real packages that are not on
# the list, several of them a keystroke from one that is: each flag on
# one is a false alarm.
